csv_project_name: Design for Wayfinding Directional Gateway & Signage
csv_scope_of_work: The intent of this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to identify and select a qualified signage, wayfinding, and graphic design professional or firm with demonstrated expertise in municipal branding, gateway signage, directional signage, facility signage, district identity signage, parks and nature interpretive signage, and comprehensive wayfinding systemsThe Consultant shall provide all professional services necessary to prepare a comprehensive, implementation-ready Citywide Signage and Wayfinding Strategy and Implementation Plan. Fabrication and installation will be by a separate proposal; however, all deliverables shall be prepared so that the City may bid and implement individual phases, sign families, or geographic areas without redesign.
